payload.text: Issue 0650, S, on vc's order of 2026-11-10: the upgrade that writes the tracked hook dispatchers also keeps a marked export-ignore block in the project's .gitattributes, edited in place when present and appended when absent, and only when the hooks directory is inside the work tree; doctor names a project whose hooks directory has tracked files and no export-ignore decision; one test reads git archive after an upgrade in a fresh repository; Intent's own .gitattributes takes the block in the same bank. The block anchors the directory at the root, `/<hooks dir> export-ignore`, because devbin's `<hooks dir>/` form matches a directory of that name at any depth. Worktree tmp/wt-ic-0650 at base 1fe4a4bec, not main bfb81c32d as this item first said. Done: fix-v1 is banked whole at refs/bank/ic/0650/fix-v1-on-1fe4a4bec (blob bda6c11cda55, patch_id 947d3cb74461, 9 files, +432 -4), and the worktree's index is exactly that bank.
